episodes.title: That '70s Pilot
episodes.summary: Point Place, Wisconsin, May 17, 1976. Nerdy teenager Eric, who smokes weed with some classmates in the basement, is in heaven when his dad Red decides to hand him the keys of his flashy Vista Cruiser, at the price of extra chores and forbidding him to take it out of town, knowing that won't be obeyed anyway. The gang, which just adopted foreign exchange student Fez, is excited about a Todd Rundgren concert- Jackie uses her female charms to make sure skirt-chaser Michael Kelso would take her too.

episodes.title: Eric's Birthday
episodes.summary: Eric's 17th birthday is approaching, and he tries to prevent his mother, Kitty, from throwing him a surprise birthday party. Donna tells Jackie she kissed Eric, and Jackie helps her choose a meaningful gift for him. Meanwhile, Eric's older sister, Laurie, returns home from college for a visit.

episodes.title: Streaking
episodes.summary: The guys decide to streak when President Gerald Ford comes to town for a campaign stop. The town committee chooses Red to ask the President a question and Donna refuses to wear an American flag jumpsuit her father, Bob, gives her.

episodes.title: Battle of the Sexists
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna argue, after she continually defeats him in various sports and games. Jackie pressures Donna to let Eric win, while Hyde and Fez pressure Kelso to stand up to Jackie. Red's job hours at the auto plant are cut back and he is forced to stay home, keeping himself occupied by "fixing" things, much to Kitty's dismay.

episodes.title: Eric's Burger Job
episodes.summary: Eric gets a job at the local Fatso Burger, but doesn't enjoy it. Donna tries to get Eric to come over, since her parents are out of town, but he doesn't understand her hints. Instead, Kelso wants to throw a party at Donna's house.

episodes.title: The Keg
episodes.summary: The gang throws a party in a pool at a real estate model home after finding a keg while skipping school. Eric searches for a tap but Red and Bob find out about the party and try to locate the kids, while Kitty gets Bob's wife Midge drunk.

episodes.title: That Disco Episode
episodes.summary: The gang plan to go to a disco in Kenosha. Kitty teaches Hyde how to dance, and Bob mistakenly thinks they are having an affair. Jackie dances with Fez and Hyde with Donna, leaving Eric and Kelso slightly jealous.

episodes.title: Drive-In
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna go to the drive-in with Kelso and Jackie. Fez's host parents won't allow him to listen to rock music, so Hyde intervenes. Red and Kitty try to go out to eat at a fancy restaurant.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Laurie brings her friend Kate home with her for Thanksgiving. Red's mother, Bernice, constantly calls, asking about Thanksgiving dinner, much to Kitty's annoyance. Red is reluctant to accept a job offer from Bob.

episodes.title: Sunday, Bloody Sunday
episodes.summary: Red's unbearable mother comes to spend a Sunday with the family. Kitty tries to quit smoking, and Eric has a school paper due. Kelso wants to break up with Jackie, but doesn't know how to tell her.

episodes.title: Eric's Buddy
episodes.summary: Eric starts hanging out with his lab partner, Buddy, which leaves his friends feeling neglected. Red is having trouble helping customers at Bob's appliance store, Bargain Bob's.

episodes.title: The Best Christmas Ever
episodes.summary: Red gives Eric $40 to buy a Christmas tree, but he, Hyde and Kelso cut one down along the interstate and keep the money for beer and presents. Red is forced by Bob to spend his Christmas Eve at the store. Laurie spikes the punch with vodka at Eric's Christmas party.

episodes.title: Ski Trip
episodes.summary: Kelso makes out with campus chick Pam Macey, causing Jackie to dump him. She invites everyone but Kelso to her ski cabin, but soon regrets it. Hyde decides to make a risky move on Donna, which he fails at and Donna ends up slapping him in the face. Kitty releases an old grudge on Red involving their younger years.

episodes.title: Stolen Car
episodes.summary: Red takes away the keys to Eric's Vista Cruiser after he notices a scratch on it, so the guys drive around in Kelso's cousin's car, which turns out to be stolen and the guys are detained. Jackie wants to have sex with Kelso and is anxiously waiting for him. Bob isn't too pleased Midge is taking a female empowerment class.

episodes.title: That Wrestling Show
episodes.summary: Kitty wants Red to hang out with Eric, so he goes with the gang to a wrestling match. After sleeping with him, Jackie is willing to do anything for Kelso, so he won't get bored with her. Hyde and Fez listen to Bob's stories about his problems with Midge and her classes, in exchange for beer. Kitty and Laurie attend Midge's therapy session, but discover it's not what it seems to be.

episodes.title: The First Date
episodes.summary: It's Valentine's Day and Eric wants to take Donna on their first date and give her his class ring, much to Hyde's displeasure. At the restaurant things are going well, until the waiter accidentally serves Donna a spiked drink.

episodes.title: The Pill
episodes.summary: Jackie confides in Eric that she might be pregnant and Kelso is the father. When Eric spills the beans to Donna, she goes to Midge and tells her she wants to go on the pill. When Bob goes to the pharmacy to pick her prescription up, both he and Eric are in for a surprise when the pharmacist tells Bob what the prescription is.

episodes.title: The Career Day
episodes.summary: The gang goes to work with their parents on career day. Eric works with Kitty at the hospital, while Hyde and Fez visit Hyde's mom, Edna, a lunch lady. Donna visits her father at "Bargain Bob's" and inadvertently tells him she is embarrassed by his career. Kelso tries to understand his father's profession, and Jackie and Red bond over fixing the Vista Cruiser.

episodes.title: Prom Night
episodes.summary: Kelso takes Pam Macey to the prom to make Jackie jealous, so Jackie goes with Hyde instead. Eric rents a hotel room intending to have sex with Donna. Midge wants to start her own business, but Bob opposes the idea.

episodes.title: A New Hope
episodes.summary: The gang sees Star Wars and Kelso is instantly obsessed, wanting to see it over and over again. Red is given his full-time status back at the plant. Meanwhile, Eric is annoyed with the son of Red's boss, David Milbank, trying to hit on Donna, prompting him to have a Star Wars dream. Eric later finds out from David that the plant will be closing soon and hits him in the face.

episodes.title: Water Tower
episodes.summary: When the gang climbs up the water tower to paint a pot leaf on the side, Kelso falls over the side and hurts himself. Meanwhile, Eric is unable to pay attention to anything after walking in on his parents. When Laurie finds out what Eric went through, she spills the beans to their parents, and eventually gets "the birds and the bees" talk from them.

episodes.title: Punk Chick
episodes.summary: While hanging out with Fez, Hyde meets a Punk Chick who invites him to go with her to New York. When Eric learns of his plans, he tries to talk Hyde out of leaving. Elsewhere, Kelso looks to Red for help in making the perfect ping pong paddles, and Kitty helps Jackie with her home economics project.

episodes.title: Grandma's Dead
episodes.summary: When Red's mother dies unexpectedly when Eric drives her home one night, each member of the Forman family has to deal with their grief in their own way.

episodes.title: Hyde Moves In
episodes.summary: Kelso suggests that the gang goes skinny dipping and somebody steals their clothes. When Hyde suggests they go to his place since his mom skipped town, Eric tells him he should move in with his family. However, when he refuses, Eric tells his parents of Hyde's predicament and they scheme up a way to get him to move in.

episodes.title: The Good Son
episodes.summary: Eric is annoyed when his parents seem to favor Hyde more than him, and sets about coercing Hyde to do destructive things. Meanwhile, Red's old war buddy, Bull, returns to Point Place. Red, jealous of Bull's success, reconsiders his life choices, but changes his mind after Bull and his wife invite Red and Kitty to a swingers party.

episodes.title: Garage Sale
episodes.summary: Hyde makes "special brownies" for the Formans' garage sale, but things don't go the way he intends when Red, Kitty, Bob and Midge eat all the brownies. A stoned Red accidentally sells Eric's Vista Cruiser and Fez kisses Jackie, which only earns him a punch in the face from Kelso.

episodes.title: Red's Last Day
episodes.summary: On his last day of work at the plant, a depressed Red gets drunk with his co-workers at a bar. Kelso gets a new van and Laurie starts to get a little amorous with him. Jackie and Donna talk about sex.

episodes.title: The Velvet Rope
episodes.summary: Tired of her parents' odd behavior, Donna forces Eric, Hyde and Fez to take her to a dance club in Chicago, but initially only Donna is let in, forcing the guys to think ways to get in. Kelso gets a makeover from Jackie, and Red starts looking for other jobs in town but hits a snag when he finds his former co-workers from the plant are after the one job he discovers.

episodes.title: Laurie and the Professor
episodes.summary: One of Laurie's college professors tries to get her to return to classes. Eric discovers his real reason for being at the Forman house and attempts to blackmail his sister with the information. Meanwhile, Hyde is having difficulty finding a suitable place to sleep and Donna is the center of her parents' fighting, as they attempt woo her favors by taking her shopping.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.summary: The gang is at odds with each other after finding their old permanent records on Halloween night at their old, burned down elementary school. Many secrets are revealed. These include: that Donna used to streak; Kelso had to repeat the first grade; Jackie's middle name is Beulah; Eric was responsible for the first time Hyde got in trouble; the time Hyde kissed Donna; and Jackie saying that Fez was a better kisser than Kelso. Meanwhile, Red and Kitty reminisce about their first Halloween at Point Place.

episodes.title: Vanstock
episodes.summary: The gang heads off to "Vanstock" and Laurie tags along. Donna is upset with Eric for not telling her about Kelso and Laurie, while Hyde fools around with the knowledge on their relationship to Jackie and Laurie, much to Kelso's dismay. Back at home, Red begins to watch soap operas under Midge's influence.

episodes.title: I Love Cake
episodes.summary: After Donna says "I love you", Eric responds strangely and is confused with how he should return his feelings. Jackie buys Kelso a jacket which makes him resemble Fonzie and Bob is kicked out of the house by Midge. Bob moves in with the Formans, much to Red and Kitty's dismay, forcing Red to come up with a plan to get him back into his own home.

episodes.title: Sleepover
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna sleep together but don't have sex. This prompts many jokes from the guys, convincing Eric he must do it the next time. Seeing money is tight in the Forman home, Hyde goes out to find a job at a photo-developing store, where the hippie Leo is introduced.

episodes.title: Eric Gets Suspended
episodes.summary: Eric gets suspended from school after getting caught holding Donna's cigarette; as punishment, Red makes him smoke a whole pack. Jackie is upset Kelso won't let her decorate his van, and Hyde and Fez go on a double blind date.

episodes.title: Red's Birthday
episodes.summary: Red's birthday turns sour when Bob and Midge show up for dinner, but with their own dates. Eric thinks Donna doesn't confide with him as much as she does with others, while Jackie suspects Kelso is keeping something from her.

episodes.title: Laurie Moves Out
episodes.summary: Laurie moves out of the house and lies to Red about living with another man. Jackie's suspicion with Kelso cheating on her grows, thus he asks Hyde how to keep covering up his secrets.

episodes.title: Eric's Stash
episodes.summary: Eric wants to buy an anniversary present for Donna, but discovers his secret stash of money has been stolen. His suspicions on who the culprit is could lead to broken friendships. Meanwhile, Jackie enters a beauty pageant with Kelso as her "pageant boy".

episodes.title: Hunting
episodes.summary: The guys and husbands go deer hunting, while the girls and wives stay at home and play poker, which Laurie cheats at so Kitty can win. Red has a heart-to-heart talk over his angry behavior with Eric.

episodes.title: Red's New Job
episodes.summary: A new department store, Price Mart, is opening and Red seeks a managerial position, until Eric is hired as a stock boy first, much to his annoyance. Meanwhile, Laurie wants a real relationship with Kelso, and Kelso is unsure if he should continue dating her. He tries to end it, until Laurie threatens him with revealing his infidelity to Jackie.

episodes.title: Burning Down the House
episodes.summary: Jackie wants to throw a small, classy party, but Kelso ruins it by inviting everyone. Things get even worse when he accidentally sets her house on fire. Red discovers Bob's secret that he wears a toupee.

episodes.title: The First Time
episodes.summary: Bob and Midge plan to have a second wedding, intending for Donna to write their vows, but she doesn't know how to put them into words. Kitty is upset at not being one of Midge's bridesmaids, while Kelso proves to Jackie he isn't as clueless about the two of them as she thinks he is.

episodes.title: Afterglow
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna have sex for the first time. Eric is dismayed to discover he was "awkward and weird." Red gets his first paycheck from Price Mart and celebrates by purchasing a motorcycle, which Kitty objects to at first.

episodes.title: Kitty and Eric's Night Out
episodes.summary: Red tells Eric to go out with Kitty so they can spend some quality time together, while Hyde is confused why a girl from a previous blind date is going out with Fez. Donna notices a stirring jealously from Jackie towards Fez's new girl.

episodes.title: Parents Find Out
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna have to tell their parents they were caught having sex in the back of Eric's Vista Cruiser by the police. Kitty becomes depressed and bedridden over this and Kelso installs a new CB radio in his van.

episodes.title: Kiss of Death
episodes.summary: Kelso decides to break up with Laurie, but after she requests a goodbye kiss, Jackie notices and breaks up with him. Eric inadvertently runs over Donna's cat, Mr. Bonkers, and Fez is sent to the hospital after experiencing sharp, stabbing pains in his abdomen.

episodes.title: Kelso's Serenade
episodes.summary: Kelso wants to win Jackie back by writing her a song, but Jackie turns to the unlikeliest person for comfort. Meanwhile, Red, Kitty and Laurie have to spend the weekend with bitter Aunt Pearl, and Eric and Donna get into communication problems.

episodes.title: Jackie Moves On
episodes.summary: Fez asks Jackie out for a date, but it doesn't go as he plans. Eric and Laurie's sibling rivalry heats up as embarrassing secrets about one another are revealed, and Red is upset when Kitty reveals she pawned his mother's necklace to buy food.

episodes.title: Holy Crap!
episodes.summary: Eric and Laurie quit going to church, which worries Kitty, and Jackie becomes attracted to Kelso when he starts growing a beard.

episodes.title: Red Fired Up
episodes.summary: Red redirects his anger away from Eric onto Earl, one of his slacker employees at Price Mart. This makes Eric happy until Red fires Earl, leaving Eric to question his father's work attitude. Kelso dates Laurie again and the gang isn't too happy with his choice.

episodes.title: Cat Fight Club
episodes.summary: Hyde teaches Jackie to be Zen when Laurie insults her. Red finds out that Kelso is dating Laurie and decides to set him straight.

episodes.title: Moon Over Point Place
episodes.summary: Eric is jealous when a picture of Donna mooning the camera appears in the yearbook. Bob is still uneasy knowing Eric is sleeping with Donna, and Jackie's constant affection for Hyde leads to a situation which lands Hyde in jail.

episodes.title: Reefer Madness
episodes.summary: Since Red learns what Hyde is in jail for, he is thinking about kicking Hyde out. To keep that from happening, Eric wonders if he should tell Red about his marijuana use. Jackie becomes infatuated with Hyde, even if he doesn't love her back.

episodes.title: Red Sees Red
episodes.summary: Red puts the Forman house under a strict curfew after Eric reveals his marijuana use, booby-trapping the house. Laurie is happy about Eric's situation until she discovers she's under the curfew as well, and Kitty does everything to make Red change his mind.

episodes.title: Hyde's Father
episodes.summary: Hyde's father, Bud, returns to Point Place, but Hyde is reluctant to make amends, while Kitty tries to get them to reconcile. However, Red doesn't think it's a good idea for Hyde to get back with Bud. Meanwhile, Donna is angry at Eric for keeping a stash of Playpen magazines under his bed.

episodes.title: Too Old to Trick or Treat, Too Young to Die
episodes.summary: The gang share a strange Halloween, complete with comic spoofs of several Alfred Hitchcock movies. Eric has vertigo after falling off the garage roof, Fez and Hyde spy on the Pinciottis, thinking Bob killed Midge, while Donna wants to prove to Eric that she's not boring. Meanwhile, Kitty and Laurie have a hard time feeding a neighbor's birds and a paperboy whom Red forgot to pay mistakes Kelso for someone in the Forman family and stalks him.

episodes.title: Roller Disco
episodes.summary: Jackie and Fez compete together in a roller disco, which could prove useful for Fez towards winning her heart. Red gets sued by a former Price Mart employee for wrongful termination.

episodes.title: Eric's Panties
episodes.summary: Donna suspects Eric is cheating on her after finding a pair of panties in his car, but its owner turns out to be someone she knows. Kitty is concerned with Red's high blood pressure and puts him on a less than satisfactory diet.

episodes.title: Baby Fever
episodes.summary: Kitty wants to have another child after taking care of a neighbor's baby. Donna is not pleased with Eric's vision of their future with her as a housewife and Kelso demands payment from Jackie after she crashes his van. However, when Hyde attempts to "help" it turns out that Kelso owes Jackie more than she does him; she doesn't even have to pay him back for the damages.

episodes.title: Jackie Bags Hyde
episodes.summary: It's Veterans Day and Bob throws a Veterans Day barbecue party, which Red usually does every year, fueling a rivalry between the neighbors. Hyde finally realizes he likes Jackie enough to ask her out on a date.

episodes.title: Hyde's Christmas Rager
episodes.summary: Red and Kitty try to set Bud straight about parenting after Eric gets drunk during a Christmas party at Hyde's apartment. Jackie takes Donna out so they can meet older men, but she is in for a shock.

episodes.title: Ice Shack
episodes.summary: Kelso takes Eric, Donna, Jackie and Fez to an ice shack where he intends to win Jackie back. Leo asks Hyde to get something for him, which could land Hyde in jail again, and Red confronts Laurie with what she plans to do with her life.

episodes.title: Who Wants It More?
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna stop having sex after arguing on a school assignment. Kelso convinces Hyde, Fez and Leo to go UFO hunting with him, while a near-death experience enlightens Red on the idea of friendship.

episodes.title: Fez Gets the Girl
episodes.summary: Fez becomes attracted to a new transfer student, Caroline, while Donna scores two tickets to a Led Zeppelin concert, but doesn't know who to take, so she gives one ticket to Caroline and the other ticket to Fez much to their delight.. Red is concerned Eric will put off a college education and Kitty becomes Laurie's model for a cosmetic assignment at beauty school.

episodes.title: Dine and Dash
episodes.summary: Kelso takes the gang out to dinner, but reveals he has no intention of paying. Kitty thinks Red should offer an unemployed Bob a job at Price Mart.

episodes.title: Radio Daze
episodes.summary: Donna gets a job at a radio station and Eric feels like she's spending more time there than with him. Kelso wants to buy Leo's El Camino and Red feels guilty after a Fatso Burger employee he's familiar with is fired over a complaint he makes.

episodes.title: Donna's Panties
episodes.summary: Eric pulls down Donna's pants during a game of basketball and her "Granny Panties" are exposed and Eric must deal with the repercussions. Valentine's Day occurs and Kelso makes a shocking discovery about Laurie.

episodes.title: Romantic Weekend
episodes.summary: Eric and Donna go away for a romantic weekend at a hotel, but find someone else at the same place, putting their plans off. When Kelso underperforms during a makeout session with another girl, he fears for his waning libido.

episodes.title: Kitty's Birthday (Is That Today?!)
episodes.summary: Eric and Red forget Kitty's birthday and the two must make up by doing something she's wanted to do for a long time. Kelso decides to be Jackie's "boy-friend" and Hyde finds Caroline's obsession with Fez a little disturbing.

episodes.title: The Trials of Michael Kelso
episodes.summary: Jackie tests Kelso to see if they should get back together and Eric and Hyde help Fez take revenge on a rival school for bullying him. Red and Kitty are curious as to why Bob and Midge didn't invite them to a party.

episodes.title: Eric's Naughty No-No
episodes.summary: Eric tries a move he sees in a dirty movie on Donna. After being honest with Jackie concerning his whereabouts, Kelso decides to tell Jackie all the lies and secrets he has kept from her, with Hyde's assistance. Kitty's younger sister, Paula, comes for a visit, under false pretenses.

episodes.title: Holy Craps!
episodes.summary: Kitty makes everyone help her at a church fundraiser, but not according to the way she wants. A churchgoer warns Eric about a future with Donna and Fez must decide whether he should stay with an obsessed Caroline.

episodes.title: Fez Dates Donna
episodes.summary: Fez pretends to date Donna in a ruse to avoid Caroline, while Eric and Hyde start a money pool to see when Kelso and Jackie will argue and bicker again. After looking at his property deed, Bob believes he owns part of Red's property, which frustrates him.

episodes.title: Eric's Drunken Tattoo
episodes.summary: Eric reads Donna's diary and decides to get a tattoo, believing he's not dangerous enough for her. Kelso talks in his sleep, fueling Jackie's curiosity, and Red spends a day with Pastor Dave when Red's band-aid accidentally gets on Pastor Dave's food.

episodes.title: Canadian Road Trip
episodes.summary: The guys and Leo go to Canada for beer, but are forced to smuggle Fez when he doesn't have his green card. Donna believes Jackie is being set up by a false modeling agency and Red tests out a recently bought Betamax recorder.

episodes.title: Backstage Pass
episodes.summary: Donna ditches Eric backstage at a Ted Nugent concert and Kelso delivers a romantic, love-filled day for Jackie, while Red and Kitty can't recall their first meeting with one another.

episodes.title: The Promise Ring
episodes.summary: Eric gives Donna a promise ring, as a sign they will be together forever. However, Donna is unsure if she's ready for such a commitment and questions their future together.

episodes.title: It's a Wonderful Life
episodes.summary: Eric is absolutely devastated over his and Donna's break-up, and spends all day in bed wishing they never had kissed. But asleep an angel comes to show Eric, how his and the gang's lives had turned if he and Donna had never been together.

episodes.title: Eric's Depression
episodes.summary: Eric is depressed about Donna and Kitty orders Red to talk to him. Hyde, Fez, Kelso and Jackie go to Funland.

episodes.title: Pinciotti vs. Forman
episodes.summary: Following their breakup, Eric kicks Donna out of hanging with the gang in the basement. As a result, they get in a bitter fight over who gets to hang out with their friends and where. Meanwhile, Kitty isn't happy when Red's newfound friendship with Pastor Dave doesn't turn out like she expected.

episodes.title: Hyde Gets the Girl
episodes.summary: Hoping to curb Hyde's cynicism about romance, Eric and Fez throw a party to find him a girlfriend. Also, Kelso tries to win a van in a "hands on" contest.

episodes.title: Bye-Bye Basement
episodes.summary: Kitty decides to redo the basement with Leo's cousin Theo as the contractor; Fez takes ballet classes to meet girls.

episodes.title: The Relapse
episodes.summary: After her mom leaves her dad, Donna turns to Eric for comfort, but he interprets it as much more; Fez goes looking for an older woman.

episodes.title: Uncomfortable Ball Stuff
episodes.summary: Both parties go to great lengths to assure that "it's not a date" when Donna accompanies Eric to the Pricemart Ball; Leo hires Fez at the Fotohut.

episodes.title: Donna's Story
episodes.summary: Donna denies her short story is really about herself and Eric---who's cast in a bad light; Red clashes with Bob's new lady friend.

episodes.title: Forgotten Son
episodes.summary: Eric's doubly depressed: Red picks Kelso to star in his company training film about Eric's job; and Donna and Kitty are new fast friends.

episodes.title: Red and Stacey
episodes.summary: Red wants lovelorn Eric to date a new Pricemart cashier, but she likes a different Forman; Jackie and Donna give Big Rhonda a makeover for her first date with Fez.

episodes.title: The Third Wheel
episodes.summary: Hyde's girlfriend spoils "guys' night out" for Eric; Pastor Dave resigns, and credits Red; Donna finds Joanne staying over; Jackie gets jealous when Big Rhonda is "in the loop."

episodes.title: An Eric Forman Christmas
episodes.summary: Eric's Christmas Sprit isn't burning the brightest, resulting in Kitty volunteering him to direct the Church's annual Christmas pageant, in an attempt to get him in the holiday mood. However, with his friends wanting him to change everything about the pageant, Eric gets so cynical that he quits and goes home. It takes Leo to get the others to remember what Christmas is all about, who in turn share what they learned with Eric, who agrees to come back to help with the pageant.

episodes.title: Jackie Says Cheese
episodes.summary: Jackie has to choose between money or Kelso; a new exchange student unnerves Fez; condoms cause stress for the Formans.

episodes.title: Eric's Hot Cousin
episodes.summary: Eric's cousin Penny has grown since her last visit, making an impression on both the girls and the boys, including (gulp) Eric.

episodes.title: Tornado Prom
episodes.summary: A tornado threatens the Snow Prom, where Jackie's runner-up finish for Snow Queen prompts a parody of "The Wizard of Oz."

episodes.title: Donna Dates a Kelso
episodes.summary: Kelso's brother dates Donna as Eric prepares for a dating onslaught after being chosen his school's "most eligible."

episodes.title: Kelso's Career
episodes.summary: Kelso's brother stands Donna up; Eric struggles to respond when Red says "I love you"; Kelso finds a dream job to buy Jackie a Valentine's Day gift.

episodes.title: Leo Loves Kitty
episodes.summary: Red is undisturbed when an injured Leo falls in love with his nurse, Kitty; Jackie's steamed when Kelso lands her dream job of model.

episodes.title: Jackie's Cheese Squeeze
episodes.summary: Eric sees Jackie kissing her boss and says he'll keep it secret, but does so only from Kelso; Red's more interested in his Corvette than his Kitty.

episodes.title: Class Picture
episodes.summary: The gang recalls past experiences, including Donna and Eric's meeting; Jackie and Kelso's first date; and Eric and Hyde's...bath?

episodes.title: Prank Day
episodes.summary: Hyde, Fez and Eric's retaliatory prank on Kelso goes awry, bringing Red into the fray; Jackie devotes herself to cheering up Donna.

episodes.title: Eric's Corvette Caper
episodes.summary: Eric lets his date drive Red's corvette but ends up having to rush it home when Kitty and Red come back to town early; Jackie and Donna sneak into Casey's room.

episodes.title: Hyde's Birthday
episodes.summary: The gang tries to steal a street sign for Hyde, who insists on no party for his 18th birthday. But that doesn't stop Kitty.

episodes.title: That '70s Musical
episodes.summary: Roger Daltrey plays music teacher to Fez, who imagines his friends in musical presentations as he prepares to perform in a school show.

episodes.title: Eric's False Alarm
episodes.summary: Eric takes action after learning Donna is going to a motel with Casey; Red and Kitty counsel Bob and Joanne after a disagreement; Kelso decides to stalk Jackie to make sure she's not kissing someone else.

episodes.title: Everybody Loves Casey
episodes.summary: Eric hopes he'll shine next to Casey when Donna brings him to his parents' barbecue; Jackie and Kelso examine why they cheated on each other.

episodes.title: Love, Wisconsin Style
episodes.summary: Donna's troubles are only beginning after she is spotted drunk in the middle of the day ("like Sue Ellen on `Dallas!' " Eric notes).

episodes.title: Going to California
episodes.summary: Eric goes to California to express his love for Donna, meanwhile Kelso tries to talk Annette into bed.

episodes.title: I Can't Quit You Baby
episodes.summary: Bob punishes Donna by sending her to Catholic school, which Eric opposes---until he sees her in uniform; Jackie is caught with her new beau.

episodes.title: What Is and What Should Never Be
episodes.summary: Red's joy is substantially less than Kitty's when she announces she's pregnant; Hyde tries to tell Kelso about himself and Jackie.

episodes.title: Heartbreaker
episodes.summary: Kitty's parents hear the news of their daughter's pregnancy; Eric and Donna counsel Kelso about Jackie and Hyde.

episodes.title: Ramble On
episodes.summary: Donna's gift to Eric has beautiful sentiment, but no visual appeal; Kitty's mood swings strain Red; Fez applies at the DMV.

episodes.title: Over the Hills and Far Away
episodes.summary: Bob throws a monkey wrench into Donna and Eric's plans when he sends her to visit a college different from where Eric is going.

episodes.title: Hot Dog
episodes.summary: Eric gets Donna a very special gift to show his feelings, while Red gets Kitty a dog in an attempt to quell hers.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.summary: Thanksgiving brings Kitty's parents, Eric's sister Laurie and Kelso with a date---Eric's math teacher, who has just failed Eric.

episodes.title: Black Dog
episodes.summary: Hyde is little comfort when Jackie has a family crisis, and Donna and Eric differ on what he should do; Fez kisses his DMV boss.

episodes.title: The Crunge
episodes.summary: When the gang get their SAT results back, Eric freaks out when he discovers he got the lowest score of the group. As a result, he goes to some drastic measures when he starts to study to retake the test. Later, Eric accidentally lets it slip to the gang that he and Donna are engaged.

episodes.title: The Girl I Love
episodes.summary: Kitty's dinner party for Fez and Nina results in a battle of the sexes, and not for just that one couple.

episodes.title: Misty Mountain Hop
episodes.summary: Hyde plans a covert party at Jackie's parents' ski cabin, unaware she's got to move out due to a foreclosure.

episodes.title: Your Time Is Gonna Come
episodes.summary: Kitty's parents visit at the same time as Kelso's California girl, who arouses jealousy in Jackie.

episodes.title: Babe I'm Gonna Leave You
episodes.summary: Hyde breaks up with Jackie, who has a war of words with Annette; Kitty and Donna react differently to Bea's cold shoulder.

episodes.title: When the Levee Breaks
episodes.summary: With her dad away, Eric sees spending the weekend at Donna's as a trial marriage, but there's one aspect he has never considered.

episodes.title: Whole Lotta Love
episodes.summary: Forbidden to yell by Kitty, Red opts to give Eric the silent treatment over his engagement with Donna. Meanwhile, Fez loses his virginity; and Kelso buys Jackie a birthday gift.

episodes.title: The Battle of Evermore
episodes.summary: Thanks to Red's constant attempts of making Eric's life miserable after finding out about his engagement to Donna, the rest of the gang decide to stay away from the Foreman residence. As a result, Hyde, Jackie, Kelso, and Fez go searching for a missing Leo. Elsewhere, Red and Eric are less than thrilled when Kitty signs them up to compete in Point Place's Pioneer Days competition, where they learn they're facing Eric's arch-nemesis Mitch Miller and his father.

episodes.title: Hey Hey What Can I Do
episodes.summary: Now that Red has fired him, hoping that the wedding will be cancelled, Eric decides to go with his friends to a local job fair. While there, Hyde gets a job working for an old friend and Kelso decides to become a cop in order to extend the amount of time to maintain his good looks.

episodes.title: Bring It on Home
episodes.summary: Friends debate what Jackie should do after it's revealed she's been living alone; Fez meets Nina's parents.

episodes.title: No Quarter
episodes.summary: Donna finds Jackie a trying roommate; Eric can't make his engagement-ring payment; Kelso gets a job working under Hyde.

episodes.title: Trampled Under Foot
episodes.summary: Nina breaks up with Fez, citing his neediness; the gang decides they need a new friend, but not the one Kitty suggests.

episodes.title: You Shook Me
episodes.summary: Fez has an erotic dream about a certain member of the gang, which greatly disturbs him. Kelso questions his own sexuality after hearing about Fez's dream, leading him to seek comfort in Jackie. Joanne offers Eric a job at a local dog food factory.

episodes.title: Nobody's Fault But Mine
episodes.summary: Kelso catches Hyde cheating on Jackie; Fez feuds with the school-paper editor; Red fights Eric and Donna's marriage plans.

episodes.title: The Immigrant Song
episodes.summary: Red has his final say on Eric and Donna; Kelso and Hyde agree to not pursue Jackie; Fez is arrested trying to pull a senior prank.

episodes.title: Celebration Day
episodes.summary: In the fifth-season finale, Jackie plays Kelso against Hyde on a pre-graduation camping trip, where Fez hopes to get lucky before his deportation.

episodes.title: The Kids Are Alright
episodes.summary: Red's recuperation from a heart attack makes Eric feel guilty about leaving for college; and Jackie chooses between Hyde and Kelso.

episodes.title: Join Together
episodes.summary: Kelso tries to reunite Hyde and Jackie; Eric opts to put off college, so he and Donna say their last goodbyes...often.

episodes.title: Magic Bus
episodes.summary: Eric's 18th birthday comes on the last day before Donna leaves for college, and the first night Red can have sex after his heart attack.

episodes.title: The Acid Queen
episodes.summary: A woman denies having had a one-time fling with Kelso; Kitty teaches Hyde the importance of lying in a relationship.

episodes.title: I'm Free
episodes.summary: An immigration agent comes to investigate Fez and Laurie's marriage; Donna urges Kelso to take responsibility for his recent actions.

episodes.title: We're Not Gonna Take It
episodes.summary: After Joanne fires Eric from the dog food factory, he asks Roy for a job as a waiter at the hotel. The problem? Impending father Kelso also wants the job. The job interview turns into a raucous (and dish shattering) competition between the two. Red orders Fez and Laurie to get a divorce. However, a succession of expensive wedding gifts change their minds. Meanwhile, Joanne has dumped Bob. To cheer him up, Donna and Jackie sent him an anonymous basket of fudge along with a romantic card.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.summary: After Jackie is fired from the cheerleading squad, she convinces the guys to accompany her at the high school Christmas dance to make her look cool. It works too well; the high school girls suddenly view Eric as a sophisticated grown up, now that he's graduated. Donna, stuck at the radio station, overhears the gossip from a caller and storms off to put a stop to the fun. Kelso sneaks off from the dance to be with Brooke at the library. After a few words, she kind of starts to like having him around. Meanwhile, Kitty gets grumpy Red a job as a department store Santa.

episodes.title: I'm a Boy
episodes.summary: Kelso asks Hyde and Jackie to join his first date with Brooke; Eric lies about his activities to Donna; Fez chauffeurs Red to a doctor appointment.

episodes.title: Young Man Blues
episodes.summary: It's Kelso's first day as a police cadet and he gets to drive around in a police cruiser with a real cop. His first stop is the Forman house to break up a domestic disturbance (Fez and Laurie are fighting over her sex life). The encounter leaves Fez burning mad, but he gets a chance for revenge when Kelso leaves the cruiser unattended. Meanwhile, Eric attempts to fix the water pipes and lawn mower in order to prove to Red that he's not a failure. And Jackie joins a Big Sister program at school.

episodes.title: A Legal Matter
episodes.summary: Kelso plots to see his police-cadet file by breaking into the academy; Fez studies for a citizenship test to get his green card.

episodes.title: I Can See for Miles
episodes.summary: Brooke trusts Kelso to get her to a doctor's appointment; Red finds Bob's gift to him inappropriate; Jackie redecorates Hyde's room more in her style than his.

episodes.title: Sally Simpson
episodes.summary: Kelso's co-cop cadet falls for him; Kitty fears a specialist will blame her for Red's stress.

episodes.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
episodes.summary: Donna forgets to take a birth-control pill; Fez says goodbye to Kelso because of the incident with Suzy.

episodes.title: Baby Don't You Do It
episodes.summary: Donna and Eric see a pastor for premarital counseling; Kelso lies to Brooke about his grades at the police academy.

episodes.title: Who Are You
episodes.summary: Jackie's mom looks to smooth things over after her fling in Mexico; Kelso is hesitant about continuing police training.

episodes.title: Man with Money
episodes.summary: Jackie and Donna try to prove their gold-digging suspicions about Pamela, who prompts pulsing in Red's heart monitor.

episodes.title: Happy Jack
episodes.summary: Eric's response to celibacy is caught by Donna, and learned by all; Hyde and Fez visit "Mike" Kelso at the police academy.

episodes.title: Do You Think It's Alright?
episodes.summary: Eric's pain at wedding-gift registration is eased by Red, who gets hooked on Kitty's romance novel.

episodes.title: Substitute
episodes.summary: Eric quickly regrets befriending an ingratiating nemesis. Bob asks Pam to move in with him.

episodes.title: Squeeze Box
episodes.summary: Red and Hyde accidentally see Pamela topless; Donna learns Eric dated while they were broken up.
Fez finds a new desire at a wedding where Donna escorts Mitch; Kitty teaches baby care to Brooke and Kelso.

episodes.title: Sparks
episodes.summary: Eric thinks he has cursed his upcoming marriage after catching sight of Donna in her wedding gown; Red looks for a very inexpensive wedding gift.

episodes.title: My Wife
episodes.summary: The bachelor and bachelorette parties occur, but not before Donna surprises Eric with a future plan that he fears she doesn't really want.

episodes.title: Going Mobile
episodes.summary: Brooke's mother clashes with Kelso; doubts plague the happy couple as the wedding day looms.

episodes.title: The Seeker
episodes.summary: In the sixth-season finale, Donna's mom Midge returns to console her; Kitty finds a surprise in Hyde's medical history.

episodes.title: Time Is on My Side
episodes.summary: Donna debuts a new look and a new plan, while ex-fiancé Eric tries to find a plan of his own, and her father Bob juggles his ex-wife and his current girlfriend.

episodes.title: Let's Spend the Night Together
episodes.summary: When Hyde and the Forman's meet Hyde's biological father William Barnett, they're in for a surprise at learning he's a black man. However, when William announces that he's a successful businessman, he shares his suspicions that their meeting was so Hyde can inherit all his money. Meanwhile, Eric tagging along to a feminist rally with Donna doesn't turn out as he expects, and Kelso anxiously awaits the birth of his child.

episodes.title: (I Can't Get No) Satisfaction
episodes.summary: Frustrated at not being able to find a job that doesn't annoy him, Red decides to open his own Muffler Shop. Eric's attempt at petty vandalism backfires when he discovers he has a connection to the business he targeted. Meanwhile, Kelso has a new respect toward women following the birth of his daughter, and soon starts looking for a loophole in that respect when he wants to go back to his immature ways.

episodes.title: Beast of Burden
episodes.summary: Eric sulks when Hyde, not he, is offered a job in Red's new muffler shop, while Fez applies to be a beauty salon's shampoo boy.

episodes.title: It's Only Rock and Roll
episodes.summary: Hyde starts working for his father in a suit and tie; Kitty joins Midge and Donna in tai-chi; Eric answers a comic-book ad for art school.

episodes.title: Rip This Joint
episodes.summary: Eric's vandalism prank goes awry; Kitty's cocktail party for herself goes south; and Hyde finds himself going capitalist.

episodes.title: Mother's Little Helper
episodes.summary: A girl stands up Kelso to go out with Fez. Also: Kitty goes on a cooking strike until Red reads "The Joy of Sex."

episodes.title: Angie
episodes.summary: Hyde's half-sister is also his co-worker---and on-the-job nemesis; Kitty lets slip that Eric's into roller disco.

episodes.title: You Can't Always Get What You Want
episodes.summary: On Thanksgiving, Hyde and Angie battle as they prepare a store's opening; and Eric plans to go to a concert rather than to the family dinner.

episodes.title: Surprise, Surprise
episodes.summary: Jackie tries to cheer Hyde after Kelso sleeps with his sister; Donna plugs Red's shop on the air until she sees the calendar he's giving out.

episodes.title: Winter
episodes.summary: The boys play with gifts Kelso appropriates from a toy drive, while the girls accompany Kitty to a holiday party run by an antagonistic rival.

episodes.title: Don't Lie to Me
episodes.summary: Jackie gets caught up in a bridal expo; Eric offers to get Hyde's sister away from Kelso.

episodes.title: Can't You Hear Me Knocking
episodes.summary: Kelso's call to the White House sends the wrong message; Kitty accompanies Red ice fishing; Jackie goes to Donna's karate class.

episodes.title: Street Fighting Man
episodes.summary: Attending a Packers game proves a bonding experience for Eric and Red, but it's a battle for ex-couple Jackie and Hyde.

episodes.title: It's All Over Now
episodes.summary: An intern undermines Donna at the radio station, which plans a live broadcast from Hyde's record store

episodes.title: On with the Show
episodes.summary: Eric bonds with a fellow layabout; Jackie debuts on cable-access TV; Angie tries to execute a successful burn to be one of the gang.

episodes.title: Down the Road Apiece
episodes.summary: Eric's road-trip video is halted by a flat tire, but helped by an old friend; Fez mediates as Jackie and Hyde tiptoe around reuniting.

episodes.title: Oh, Baby (We Got a Good Thing Goin')
episodes.summary: Kelso babysits his daughter, which interferes with Eric's romantic plans; an auto show brings out the better in Hyde, to Kitty's dismay.

episodes.title: Who's Been Sleeping Here?
episodes.summary: After Angie finds evidence that someone has been spending time overnight in the record store, she immediately accuses Hyde of the crime. However, not long after setting up a surveillance system to catch the guilty party in the act, they soon discover that Fez has been living there since his host family kicked him out of their house. Meanwhile, Kelso picks Hyde and Jackie to be Betsy's godparents, which causes a stunned Donna and Eric to find out why Kelso chose not select them for the job.

episodes.title: Gimme Shelter
episodes.summary: As Eric tries to whittle down what he'd like to do with his life, he takes Kitty's suggestion of becoming a Chiropractor to heart and goes to a seminar to see if he has what it takes. However, things go awry when attempting to give Donna an adjustment he accidentally hurts her neck so bad that she can't turn her head anymore. Kitty then gives Kelso and Fez some advice that will help with their living arrangements.

episodes.title: 2120 So. Michigan Ave
episodes.summary: When Eric finally chooses what path he wants to take after graduating from high school – becoming a teacher – he soon discovers that an incomplete in P.E. might railroad his plans. When he goes back high school to complete summer school, Eric soon discovers that Casey Kelso is teaching the class and tries to find an easy way out of the class.

episodes.title: 2000 Light Years from Home
episodes.summary: When Eric finds out that Red and Kitty spent his college funds on the muffler shop, he begins to panic on how he'll be able to pay for school. Donna then suggests that he go see their old high school guidance counselor on what he can do in order to get into college. However, that doesn't turn out as Donna and Kitty imagine: Eric decides to sign up to teach in Africa for a year in exchange for his education being paid for when he returns. Meanwhile, William returns to Point Place to tell Angie he plans to give her a promotion at work and move her to the main office in Milwaukee, ultimately causing her to break up with Kelso.

episodes.title: Take It or Leave It
episodes.summary: Jackie gives Hyde an ultimatum when she's offered a job in Chicago; and with Eric going away, Donna decides to date.

episodes.title: Short and Curlies
episodes.summary: Hyde gets another chance with Jackie; Charlie accidentally sees Kitty naked; and Donna arranges the perfect going-away present for Eric.

episodes.title: Til the Next Goodbye
episodes.summary: Eric gets his shots for Africa, which looks better and better after Red catches the boys smoking in the basement.

episodes.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
episodes.summary: Kitty makes an audio tape for Eric and admits experimenting with the boys' stash.

episodes.title: Somebody to Love
episodes.summary: Hyde sets out to fire Leo for mismanaging the record store, but ends up with a new employee; Jackie has a night out to move on from Hyde.

episodes.title: You're My Best Friend
episodes.summary: A surprise bachelor party for Hyde falls apart when the guest of honor lands in jail, while his wife gets to know his ex-girlfriend a little better.

episodes.title: Misfire
episodes.summary: Bruce Willis plays an employer interviewing Kelso, who uses the Formans' 25th-anniversary party to make a proposal.

episodes.title: Stone Cold Crazy
episodes.summary: Donna's sexy pictures for Eric repeatedly fall into the wrong hands; Jackie moves in with Fez, whose crazy ex-girlfriend better not find out.

episodes.title: Long Away
episodes.summary: Red hires Leo to take pictures at his veterans reunion; Jackie and Fez suspect Donna is cheating on Eric.

episodes.title: Fun It
episodes.summary: The gang steals the ceramic clown mascot of a burger joint, and the whole town is angry except for Red, who never could stand the thing.

episodes.title: Good Company
episodes.summary: Fez has a fling with an older woman who's one of Kitty's friends.

episodes.title: Who Needs You
episodes.summary: Hyde and Sam's constant fighting gets to Red and Kitty; Donna hosts a radio fund-raiser; and Fez and Jackie have landlord problems.

episodes.title: Sweet Lady
episodes.summary: After going to visit Fez one day at the beauty shop, Jackie runs into her favorite talk show host, and as a result, tries to impress so she can get a job working for her. Meanwhile, after Randy invites her up to his family's cabin, Donna begins to be suspicious of his intention. When Red invites Hyde to meet some married friends of his, he begins to doubt his future with Samantha.

episodes.title: Good Old Fashioned Lover Boy
episodes.summary: In her attempts to get into Christine St. George's good graces, Jackie promptly finds herself in a tight spot with Kitty. Meanwhile at the record store, Donna becomes the target of Leo's loving desire.

episodes.title: Killer Queen
episodes.summary: Red lets Hyde in on a Valentine's Day secret; Christine opens up to Jackie about her love life; and Randy has big plans for a date.

episodes.title: Spread Your Wings
episodes.summary: With memories of Eric still fresh, Donna worries how the gang will react now that she's dating Randy. Meanwhile, Fez tries to impress a coworker at the salon.

episodes.title: Son and Daughter
episodes.summary: Hyde house-sits for his father while he attends an Eric Clapton concert; Kitty is beside herself now that Donna's dating Randy.

episodes.title: Keep Yourself Alive
episodes.summary: Fez loses Kitty's engagement ring on the ride home from the county fair, so the gang goes over the river and through the woods to look for it while Red searches for the right time to tell his wife the truth about her jewelry.

episodes.title: My Fairy King
episodes.summary: Red refuses to go quietly when a national muffler chain threatens his business; Hyde learns the naked truth about his marriage to Sam; and Jackie surprises herself with her list of an ideal man's qualities.

episodes.title: Crazy Little Thing Called Love
episodes.summary: Jackie reluctantly seeks help from a therapist after she finally realizes her feelings for Fez; Red's retirement creates more work for Hyde.

episodes.title: We Will Rock You
episodes.summary: When the gang discovers that Fez and Jackie are fans of the Village People, they decide to have a "disco sucks" party where they plan to have a bonfire to burn a stack of disco records. Meanwhile, Kitty and Red invite their new neighbors over, as a welcome to the neighborhood. However, they are surprised to learn that they're a same-sex couple

episodes.title: Sheer Heart Attack
episodes.summary: Hyde shows Red a way to get rid of extra medication; Fez's latest girlfriend makes Jackie almost as crazy as she is.

episodes.title: Leaving Home Ain't Easy
episodes.summary: Donna rethinks her future after her dad announces he's moving to Florida; Jackie plots revenge on Fez for turning her down.

episodes.title: Love of My Life
episodes.summary: Fez gets a visit from a friend from home (wherever that is); Red and Kitty show their house to prospective buyers; and Hyde's father has a surprise at the store.

episodes.title: That '70s Finale
episodes.summary: In the series finale, Kelso returns on New Year's Eve 1979 to celebrate, while Red and Kitty rethink their plans to move to Florida.
